draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.84, the 199th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 25th of 28 at WR. He went 163rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (199th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (12th percentile), vertical jump (16th percentile). College production: 739 receiving yards in 2021, 22nd of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 13 career games and 0 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2023. Weak spots: receiving td 0 (13th percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2023.
